description: Helm deployment repositories: chart versions in Chart.yaml, image tags in values and environment files, and anything marked with a # renovate: comment.

customManagers.description: A value on the line after '# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name> [versioning=<v>]'.

packageRules.description: A wrapper chart's own version moves when anything it pins moves, so each merge is a new chart version.
Name the chart directory in the title: the same image is often pinned by several charts.
